seoTitle: Global Leadership Programme: Learn with AI & Mentors | MySkills
seoDescription: Fourteen short modules on the life skills employers look for, from self-awareness and empathy to leadership and coping with stress. Practise in writing and get mentor feedback. Free to start.
name: Global Leadership Programme
tagline: Use AI the way employers now expect you to.
intro: Skills get you shortlisted; how you know yourself, think, decide, work with people and handle pressure gets you hired. Learn and practise all fourteen in writing — and get a human’s honest feedback before an interviewer gives you theirs.
insideTitle: Fourteen modules, one for each skill.
insideIntro: One module for each skill in the Leadership Aptitude Test. The first five are the core of the programme; the other nine build the rest of WHO’s life skills.

modules.title: Goal Setting
modules.body: Turn “I want a good job” into specific, measurable goals — and a weekly plan that actually gets you there.
modules.ai: Break big goals into milestones with AI, then check in on your progress every week.

modules.title: Communication
modules.body: Write and speak clearly — emails, presentations, and explaining your work to a client or an interviewer.
modules.ai: Rehearse pitches and presentations and get instant AI feedback on clarity, structure and tone.

modules.title: Leadership
modules.body: Lead without a title: take ownership, run a small project, and bring people with you.
modules.ai: Role-play difficult conversations and team decisions with AI before they happen for real.

modules.title: Agile Methodology
modules.body: Work the way modern teams do — sprints, stand-ups, backlogs and short feedback loops.
modules.ai: Plan sprints and run retrospectives with AI as your scrum assistant.

modules.title: Growth Mindset
modules.body: Treat setbacks as information, and build the habits that keep you learning when things get hard.
modules.ai: Reflect on wins and setbacks with an AI coach, and spot the patterns in how you grow.

modules.title: Self-Awareness
modules.body: Know what you’re good at, what you find hard and what throws you, so you can plan around it instead of being surprised.

modules.title: Empathy
modules.body: Listen to understand rather than to reply, and see a situation from the other person’s side, even when you disagree.

modules.title: Critical Thinking
modules.body: Check where a claim comes from, weigh the evidence, and test your own views before you act on them or share them.

modules.title: Creative Thinking
modules.body: Generate lots of ideas before judging them, borrow what works elsewhere, and find another way when the usual one fails.

modules.title: Decision-Making
modules.body: Lay out your options and what each leads to, choose by a date, and learn from how it turns out.

modules.title: Problem-Solving
modules.body: Get to the real cause of a problem, weigh the possible fixes, and take the first small step today.

modules.title: Interpersonal Relationships
modules.body: Build trust with the people you work and study with, and handle disagreements without damaging the relationship.

modules.title: Coping with Stress
modules.body: Spot the early signs of stress, plan and prioritise when there’s too much to do, and build habits that help you reset.

modules.title: Coping with Emotions
modules.body: Name strong feelings as they come, pause before you respond, and handle other people’s emotions with care.

outcomesTitle: Not a certificate of attendance. Evidence.
outcomes: Clear, measurable career goals — and a plan to reach them
Confident communication in writing, presentations and interviews
Leadership experience you can point to, not just describe
Hands-on fluency with agile ways of working
A growth mindset backed by habits, not slogans
Mentor feedback on your progress, not just automated scores
